basic_profile.bio: A tech enthusiast and comic book aficionado living in Portland, Oregon. I work as a software developer by day and spend my evenings diving into the latest graphic novels or tinkering with Discord bots. I'm an early riser, typically logging onto Reddit around 6 AM and staying active until late evening. Passionate about technology, humor, and storytelling, I often look for ways to merge these interests in creative projects. Happily married to a fellow geek, and we enjoy attending comic conventions together.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have over a decade of experience in software development, specializing in web technologies and bot creation. My expertise is a mix of formal education and self-taught skills, particularly in JavaScript and its frameworks. I've built several personal projects and contribute to open-source applications.
